inspiration.observed_pattern: LTRIM and RTRIM remove leading and trailing spaces independently, while their nesting produces a canonical label.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Re-authored as a deterministic nullable contact-label normalization audit with independent left/right trims, nested canonicalization, and ordered classification.

fixture_notes: Fixed labels isolate leading-only, trailing-only, both-sided, and NULL whitespace behavior without copying the source strings.
determinism_notes: All labels are fixed literals; statements use a primary-key ordering and no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections.
setup: CREATE TABLE contact_labels (label_id INT PRIMARY KEY, label_kind VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, raw_label VARCHAR(40) NULL)
INSERT INTO contact_labels VALUES (1001, 'both-sided', '   north hub   '), (1002, 'leading-only', '   east depot'), (1003, 'trailing-only', 'west yard   '), (1004, 'missing', NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT label_id, label_kind, raw_label, LTRIM(raw_label) AS left_trimmed, RTRIM(raw_label) AS right_trimmed, LTRIM(RTRIM(raw_label)) AS canonical_label, CASE WHEN raw_label IS NULL THEN 'missing' WHEN raw_label = LTRIM(RTRIM(raw_label)) THEN 'already-canonical' ELSE 'normalized' END AS normalization_state FROM contact_labels ORDER BY label_id

checks.sql: SELECT label_id, LTRIM(RTRIM(raw_label)) AS canonical_label FROM contact_labels ORDER BY label_id
